title: Spider Exploration Game
author: Superb-Excitement927
selftext:
Apologies for the jerky camera movement and no sound -- screen recorded this with a trackpad. 



Anyway, you're a spider and you explore a infinite procedural world. Web swinging, zipping, gliding, you get the idea. Kinda fun to swing around / explore in it.

  
I don't really know what else to do with it. If anyone has ideas to game-ify it, feel free to share. If anyone is interested in playing maybe I'll publish it

comments.author: SeasawPhilosopher
comments.body: whoa, cool idea. Can I build a web and hunt my dinner?

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body:
This is a cool concept! I have arachnophobia and the animations are already making me repulsed. So you're off to a good start imo \^\^

Interesting that you went for a traversal-focused webspinning to start (rather than catching prey/feeding/hunger mechanics etc?). It's probably a lot more active/fun. Catching/waiting for prey in a realistic way, obvs too slow, but a simulated quicker version (spin a food web, fly wanders in) could give you two different game modes: travel and resting/feeding. I just noticed after typing all that you have a "firefly" counter so maybe you already do this hah. 

Why is spidey travelling? The answer could guide a lot. Are they trying to return home like a lost Matt Damon character? Are they a messenger carrying important spidery news between the treelines? Just to see how far they can wander? No reason at all?

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body:
![gif](giphy|10Jpr9KSaXLchW)

  
  
Yess. Game loads up and shows it's the Year of our Queen, 1438, or some shit. You are an eight legged medieval era royal messenger tasked with carrying notices of great import between the spidey courts. Speed, and sometimes discretion, are your watchwords. 

Or maybe you're just spidey FedEx hotdropping spidey Amazon deliveries IDK   
  
That's getting me thinking of spidey death stranding

There are a lot of fun ideas, it's a cool concept! ;p
